epi001.title: Penne with Coconut Cream Sauce
epi001.instructions:
Cook penne.
Saute garlic in olive oil, add coconut milk and simmer until thickened.
Stir in spinach and pasta.

epi002.title: Dairy-Free Creamy Pasta
epi002.instructions:
Cook pasta.
Blend cashews, broth, garlic and lemon until smooth.
Toss sauce with pasta and warm through.

epi003.title: Pasta with Cream and Peas
epi003.instructions:
Cook pasta.
Simmer cream with peas.
Toss with pasta and parmesan.

epi004.title: Lemon Olive Oil Pasta
epi004.instructions:
Cook pasta, reserving water.
Warm oil with garlic and lemon.
Toss with pasta and water until glossy.

epi006.title: Banana Oat Muffins
epi006.instructions:
Mix wet ingredients.
Fold in dry ingredients.
Bake 22 minutes.
